<description>
`p2p_eviction.py` tests that 4 inbound peers that recently sent us a novel block are protected from eviction. However, the test currently passes even when that protection is not in effect.

The block-sending peers are connected first, so they are the oldest connections. When block-time protection doesn't apply, `CompareNodeBlockTime` falls back to connection time and protects the 4 oldest peers, which are these same peers. Then the youngest remaining peer gets evicted. The check `evicted_peers[0] not in protected_peers` therefore holds whether or not block-time protection works.

This can be shown by deleting the line where the peers send their block (L71 on master):
```py
block_peer.send_blocks_and_test([block], node, success=True)
```
</description>
